Regionalization by geographically weighted regression (C3)

Source: R/regionalize-methods.R
ef_method_gwr.Rd

Describes a GWR regionalization for ef_regionalize() and ef_regionalize_cv() (configuration C3, dev/specs/gwr-forcing.md section 5.5): local weighted least squares on the covariates of the grid, fitted with ef_gwr_fit() and predicted exactly at every cell with ef_gwr_predict(). The bandwidth is either given (bandwidth) or selected for every fit by criterion over search with ef_gwr_bandwidth() (one selection per variable and target time, decision GW-11).

Usage

ef_method_gwr(
  kernel,
  adaptive,
  criterion = NULL,
  bandwidth = NULL,
  search = NULL,
  min_neighbours = NULL,
  scale_covariates = TRUE
)

Arguments

kernel

Character, no default (decision GW-04 is open): "gaussian", "exponential", "bisquare", "tricube" or "boxcar".

adaptive

Logical, no default: FALSE for a fixed bandwidth [m], TRUE for an adaptive one (k nearest stations, counting the station itself).

criterion

NULL or "AICc" / "CV": select the bandwidth of every fit by this criterion (no default, decision GW-05). Give exactly one of criterion and bandwidth.

bandwidth

NULL or a fixed bandwidth [m] (adaptive = FALSE) or a whole number of neighbours k (adaptive = TRUE), used for every fit.

search

The settings of the selection, from ef_gwr_search(); required with criterion, NULL with bandwidth.

min_neighbours

NULL or a whole number: minimum number of neighbours (see ef_gwr_fit()) with a given bandwidth; with criterion it is set in ef_gwr_search().

scale_covariates

Logical. Internal scaling of the covariates for numerical conditioning (results do not change; see ef_gwr_fit()).

Value

A list of class "earthflux_regionalization_method" with method = "gwr" and the settings.

Details

Errors: earthflux_missing_input (kernel, adaptive, or both criterion and bandwidth missing; search missing with criterion), earthflux_unknown_method (kernel or criterion), earthflux_input_error (both criterion and bandwidth, search with bandwidth, min_neighbours with criterion), earthflux_domain_error (bandwidth not positive, k not a whole number >= 1).

Verification status

See ef_gwr_fit() and ef_gwr_bandwidth(): estimator and kernels CANDIDATA (corroborada); AICc form VERIFICADA as content of Gollini et al. (2015) and CANDIDATA (corroborada) as EarthFlux definition.

See also

ef_method_station(), ef_method_ols(), ef_method_idw() for the comparison configurations C1 and C2.

Other spatial regionalization functions: ef_gwr_bandwidth(), ef_gwr_diagnostics(), ef_gwr_fit(), ef_gwr_predict(), ef_gwr_search(), ef_method_idw(), ef_method_ols(), ef_method_station(), ef_predict_control(), ef_regionalize(), ef_regionalize_cv(), ef_spatial_folds()

Examples

ef_method_gwr("bisquare", adaptive = FALSE, bandwidth = 25000)
#> <earthflux_regionalization_method> gwr 
#> kernel bisquare, fixed bandwidth, given = 25000 m
ef_method_gwr("gaussian", adaptive = TRUE, criterion = "AICc",
              search = ef_gwr_search())
#> <earthflux_regionalization_method> gwr 
#> kernel gaussian, adaptive bandwidth, selected by AICc for every fit
